commit.message:
test(agent-launch): tell the reach check's child by model, not yield

omp 18.10.2 offers task subagents no `yield` tool, so the stand-in scripted
the child as the parent and its journal read never arrived. The child's
requests are now those on model `declared` (declarations run on
fixture/declared, the session on fixture/base); the child closes with
`yield` when offered one, plain text otherwise. Assertions unchanged.
